dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a deep posterior notch and a smooth spline curvature transitioning from the apex to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Moderately rounded apex with a medium pixel radius; lacks sharp geometric vertices.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the peduncle.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of longitudinal base width to vertical height from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive light-colored mottled depigmentation or scarring across the mid-lateral flank and dorsal fin base; distinct darker punctate markings visible within white patches on the lower flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular pigmentary distribution characterized by dense, overlapping white blotches covering a significant portion of the visible epidermal surface.
